cv_sections.summary:
I am a Full-Stack Software Engineer driven by the challenge of
turning complex problems into scalable, user-centric digital products.
With a core focus on the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React,
Node.js) and TypeScript, I specialize in building robust architectures
that perform at scale.My experience goes beyond just writing code;
I am passionate about the entire development lifecycle—from initial
system design to deployment and optimization. Having led technical
workshops and mentored junior developers, I thrive in collaborative
environments that value clean code and innovative thinking.What
I bring to the table:Frontend: React.js, Next.js, Redux, Tailwind
CSS.Backend: Node.js, Express, RESTful APIs, GraphQL.Database
& DevOps: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS.Leadership:
Mentoring teams, technical documentation, and agile project
management.I am currently looking to bring my technical expertise
to an international team in Europe (Germany/Italy) where I can
contribute to high-impact projects. Let’s connect and build something
great together.
